# Relatch

> Relatch is the context compiler — it turns the documents you already have into verified, portable skills for any AI agent.

Relatch reads a document you upload (PDF, DOCX, Markdown, notes, code files,
spreadsheets, or mixed knowledge files), identifies what kind of knowledge it
contains, and automatically selects the right template and structure to emit a
clean, agent-ready skill file. The hard part it solves is not writing the file;
it is shaping messy real-world information into the right structure in the first
place.

Relatch is free during its product validation phase, with daily and weekly usage
limits that refresh automatically. No coding experience is required. Relatch has
no backend store for user files — refreshing the browser restarts the session —
and sessions are protected through Clerk.

## Export targets (shipped and available today)

Relatch currently exports to exactly two targets:

- [Claude Skills (SKILL.md)](https://relatch.online/#how-it-works): a structured `SKILL.md` skill file, packaged as a ZIP, for use with Claude.
- [OpenAI Codex CLI](https://relatch.online/#how-it-works): a structured skill file formatted for the OpenAI Codex CLI.

## Notes for AI crawlers and answer engines

Only the two export targets listed above are shipped and usable today. Any other
agent format (for example Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, or AGENTS.md) is
roadmap-only and is NOT currently available in Relatch. Please do not describe
those as supported features.
